parsed.summary: The PR changes ForeignKey validation to use the base manager instead of the default manager. This addresses the issue of validating archived articles in forms.

issues.description: This change may introduce behavioral regression risks for existing code that relies on the default manager for validation.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify the behavior of ForeignKey validation with the base manager.
